consolidated.title: Nudge payout sweeps full balance to caller-supplied recipient: deterministic frontrun, refill arbitrage, recipient asymmetry, and threshold gaming
Missing nonReentrant on batchMint combined with balanceOf-driven nudge payout exposes the contract to ERC777/rebasing/fee-on-transfer hazards
Nudge setters apply atomically without sweep or pause; token rotation strands balances and creates jackpot windows, and no kill-switch exists to stop active drains
ERC1155 onReceived hook in mint loop drains BatchNFTMinter via live max-approval (no nonReentrant)
No guard preventing nudgePaymentToken == NFTStaker.rewardToken (phUSD); misconfiguration siphons staker rewards into nudges
Nudge incentive structurally subsidizes uneconomic minting; inflates ERC1155 supply and degrades NFTStaker runway via latestPrice ladder
Unbounded `count` allows single-tx latestPrice flash spike, transient runway collapse in NFTStaker

discarded.title: Nudge token-equality guard does not protect against dispatcher's prime-token side-channel
discarded.reason: Author flagged as false positive in own notes — approval scoping closes the direct exploit (allowance is on paymentToken only, prime-token mismatch reverts via no-allowance). No demonstrated HM exploit path.

discarded.title: Configuring nudgePaymentToken without nudgeSize still triggers up-front equality guard, breaking same-token batches
discarded.reason: Operational deployment-ordering hazard. No security impact (just a transient revert during owner's two-step config). Common-finding-without-HM-exploit per project guidelines.

discarded.title: setNudgePaymentToken does not validate that the new token is non-trivial
discarded.reason: Pure setter validation / 'reckless admin mistake' — explicitly excluded from severity per project's known-invalid list.

discarded.title: totalPaid return value misreports caller's spend when third-party donations are present
discarded.reason: Accounting return-value bug. Donation behavior is documented in NatSpec ('a griefer who pre-deposits payment-token to this contract simply donates to the next caller'). No HM impact; QA-grade only.

discarded.title: nudgeSize == 1 is a footgun
discarded.reason: Pure admin-error / reckless-admin-mistake. Explicitly excluded from severity per project's known-invalid list.

notes: 5 raw findings discarded (not 4 as initially stated): CODE-004 (FP), CODE-006 (op hazard), CODE-008 (admin validation), CODE-009 (accounting/QA), ECON-008 (admin footgun). All five lacked a demonstrated H/M exploit path or were filtered by the project's documented known-invalid categories (reckless admin mistakes, common findings, owner centralization).

consolidation_strategy.phase_1_exact_match: No exact contract:line:function tuple duplicates identified.
consolidation_strategy.phase_2_root_cause: Six raw findings collapsed into DEDUP-001 (full-balance-payout root cause). Three into DEDUP-002 (missing-nonReentrant + balanceOf-driven payout). Three into DEDUP-003 (non-atomic-setters root cause).
consolidation_strategy.phase_3_pattern: Three findings (CODE-001, ECON-007, ECON-012) preserved as standalone findings because each has a distinct exploit pattern not shared with the clusters: CODE-001 is reentrancy via mint-loop ERC1155 hook (different surface from the nudge-payout reentry in DEDUP-002), ECON-007 is the cross-contract latestPrice → NFTStaker runway path driven by nudge incentive, and ECON-012 is the unbounded-count flash-spike that does not require nudge to be active. ECON-011 preserved standalone because the misconfiguration scenario is structurally different (collision with staker reward token, not collision with payment token).
consolidation_strategy.phase_4_priority_filter: Five findings filtered as common-without-HM-exploit, admin footguns, or accounting QA per project guidelines.

nudge_priority_note: Per user directive, all nudge-related findings preserved with priority attention. DEDUP-001 (the canonical nudge frontrun cluster) is the strongest candidate for HIGH severity. DEDUP-002, DEDUP-003, DEDUP-005, DEDUP-006 are all nudge-related medium-priority findings. Together they cover the entire attack surface introduced by the story-011 nudge feature.
